new_entities.name: Liothyronine (T3) addition
new_entities.description: Addition of liothyronine to background levothyroxine in patients with treated hypothyroidism.

new_entities.name: Quality of life in hypothyroid patients already on T4
aliases: quality of life during T4-treated hypothyroidism
new_entities.description: Patient-reported quality of life, mood, and symptom burden among hypothyroid patients already treated with levothyroxine.

edges.effect_quant: A meta-analysis of 11 randomized trials in 1,216 patients found no meaningful quality-of-life advantage for T4/T3 combination therapy over T4 alone (SMD 0.03, 95% CI -0.09 to 0.15), although some individual studies reported isolated psychometric or preference signals.
edges.population: adults with treated primary hypothyroidism who remained symptomatic or were evaluated for combination thyroid hormone replacement
edges.mechanism: Adding liothyronine may better mimic physiological T3 exposure in some patients, but rapid absorption and serum peaks can also create instability without consistent tissue-level benefit. That helps explain why anecdotal preference exists while pooled quality-of-life gains remain hard to demonstrate.
edges.summary: Liothyronine added to levothyroxine has mixed evidence for improving quality of life in hypothyroid patients already on T4. A few trials suggest selective psychometric or preference benefits, but pooled randomized evidence does not show a reliable broad improvement in fatigue, mood, or overall quality of life.
edges.caveats: Most trials are small, heterogeneous, and use different T4:T3 substitution ratios, so a true responder subgroup may still exist without showing up clearly in averages. This edge should not be read as proof that combination therapy never helps, only that routine add-on use has not demonstrated consistent population-level quality-of-life benefit.

evidence.citation: Grozinsky-Glasberg S 2006 J Clin Endocrinol Metab
evidence.notes: Thyroxine-triiodothyronine combination therapy versus thyroxine monotherapy for clinical hypothyroidism: meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.

effect_quant.comparator: quality of life with combination therapy versus levothyroxine alone

evidence.notes: Thyroid hormone replacement therapy in primary hypothyroidism: a randomized trial comparing L-thyroxine plus liothyronine with L-thyroxine alone.

evidence.citation: Escobar-Morreale HF 2005 J Clin Endocrinol Metab
evidence.notes: REVIEW: Treatment of hypothyroidism with combinations of levothyroxine plus liothyronine.
